subject: Invoice slot coordination + staging sync for Q3 bookings recognition
messages:
From: Samantha Patel <samantha.patel@acme-nimbus.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-nimbus.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO ETA and invoice slot for Redwood Q3 commitment

Hi Lauren,

We're finalizing the PO for the Q3 committed seats/throughput and wanted to confirm the expected invoice cut window so our finance team can recognize against the bookings cadence. Treasury is asking whether Redwood requires the PO to land in the July invoice slot (cutoff 7/25) or if August processing is acceptable without pushing revenue out of the current quarter.

Attached is the draft PO (Nimbus_PO_2028-07-22.pdf). Key notes from procurement:
- PO will reference the committed monthly throughput tier and a one-time onboarding professional service line.
- They will route via our internal Procure-to-Pay system; expected routing time is 48h after PO creation.

Can you confirm (1) whether a July invoice is possible if we provide PO by Monday 7/24 EOD, and (2) any specific invoice/data fields you need to match to our contract so revenue recognition flows cleanly?

Thanks,
Samantha Patel
Director, Procurement
ACME Nimbus
[attachment: Nimbus_PO_2028-07-22.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Samantha Patel <samantha.patel@acme-nimbus.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO ETA and invoice slot for Redwood Q3 commitment

Samantha — thanks for the PO and the clear summary. Short answer: yes, we can typically hit the July invoice slot if we receive the PO by 7/24 EOD and the PO includes the following exact fields so our billing system auto-matches:

- PO number (exact match)
- Billing contact name and email
- Purchase line item codes: RED-BASE-SUB, RED-ONBOARD-PS
- Effective start date (mm/dd/yyyy)

Plan to move this forward:
1) Ben — can you confirm that Finance can issue an invoice on 7/25 if the PO is entered into our system by EOD 7/24? If there are any manual checks that could delay processing, flag them now.
2) Vanessa — please prepare the draft invoice (Invoice_9876-draft.xlsx) with line items mapping to the codes above so we can swap PO number in after approval.
3) Karthik — I need a quick note on whether we should hold recognition on the onboarding PS until delivery milestone M1 or if it should be booked as deferred revenue and recognized over the 3-month onboarding period.

Samantha: if you can confirm the PO routing SLA and whether they will populate the PO number before sending it to us, that will avoid a manual match on our side.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Samantha Patel <samantha.patel@acme-nimbus.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO ETA and invoice slot for Redwood Q3 commitment

Lauren / Samantha — we can hit the 7/25 invoice run if the PO is fully entered in our billing portal by COB 7/24. Two caveats: (a) any manual PO number reconciliation will push us to the next run, and (b) if the PO includes non-standard payment terms (net-45/60) we need to tag the invoice accordingly which sometimes requires Finance review (adds ~24-48h).

Action items from Finance side:
- I will queue the proposed invoice for 7/25 but mark it "pending PO match". Once the PO number is provided we can complete the match and release.
- If Samantha can confirm the PO number in the initial transmission (or in a follow-up email within 12h of po creation) we are golden for July recognition.

Vanessa — please share the draft invoice version in Drive and tag BILL-314 so I can attach it to the invoice run.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations (Billing)
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Patel <samantha.patel@acme-nimbus.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO ETA and invoice slot for Redwood Q3 commitment

Quick confirmation/update after procurement routed the PO overnight:

- Samantha confirmed the PO will include the PO number and billing contact and routed today (7/22) with expected internal approval completed by 7/24.
- Attached I pushed a clean draft invoice into Drive: Invoice_9876-draft.xlsx (link below). Vanessa, please finalize the invoice with the RED- codes and leave the PO number field blank so Ben can populate on release.

Samantha — appreciate the quick routing. If for any reason the PO approval slips past 7/24, notify Ben and Lauren immediately; we'll then schedule recognition for the next run and update the bookings commit.

Drive links:
- Draft invoice: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d-PO-Nimbus

Thanks all — aiming to close this in the July run and reflect in Q3 bookings.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
